contests.title: Lamoni Community School District — Measure GB: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Lamoni Community School District in the Counties of Decatur and Ringgold, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $5,750,000 to be used together with sales tax revenue bonds to provide funds to build, furnish and equip an addition to its Elementary School, with related remodeling and improvements and related site improvements; to remodel, repair, improve, furnish, and equip the Elementary School, including HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing improvements; to remodel, repair, and improve the Middle School, including exterior façade restoration; and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the High School, including fire suppression, HVAC improvements, and a new secured entry?

contests.title: Central Decatur Community School District — Measure GA: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Central Community School District of Decatur County in the County of Decatur, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $11,955,000 to provide funds to build, furnish and equip an elementary addition to its North Elementary School, with related remodeling and improvements and site improvements; to remodel, repair, improve, furnish, and equip the North Elementary school for consolidated elementary programming; to demolish the existing South Elementary School; and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the Junior-Senior High School, including replacement of its exterior doors, secure entry vestibule upgrades, and HVAC improvements?

contests.title: PCM Community School District — Measure LL: School improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Jasper County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the PCM Community School District in the Counties of Jasper, Polk, and Marion, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $14,195,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the Monroe campus, including classroom and career and technical education spaces; to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the Monroe campus, including a multipurpose performance gymnasium, support spaces, and site improvements; and to improve the Prairie City campus site, including playgrounds and parking?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $5.75 million in general-obligation bonds, to be used together with sales-tax revenue bonds, for an elementary school addition and renovations, heating, cooling and other building systems, middle school exterior façade restoration, and high school fire suppression, heating and cooling and a new secure entry.

Authorizes up to $11.955 million in general-obligation bonds for a North Elementary addition, renovations for consolidated elementary programs and site improvements; demolition of South Elementary; and junior-senior high school renovations, including exterior doors, a secure entry and heating and cooling.

Authorizes up to $14.195 million in general-obligation bonds for Monroe campus classroom and career and technical education renovations, an addition with a multipurpose performance gymnasium and support spaces, and Prairie City campus playground and parking improvements.
